transcript: My name is Amanda Erdysing, and I'm preparing for a cloud engineer role. I have hand-on practice with AWS, Linux, and Terraform. I work on a student management system in the Education domain. My main contribution was student records. The challenge was unclear requirements. I discussed it with my team, tested the fix, and the system reduced duplicate records.
feedback: Amanda, you did a great job explaining your experience as a cloud engineer. You provided specific examples from your project, such as reducing duplicate records in the student management system. However, your answer could be more structured and clear.
strengths: Experience with AWS, Linux, and Terraform
weaknesses: Lack of clear structure in the answer
Some parts of the answer were unclear
suggestions: Provide a clear and concise introduction to your experience
Use a more structured approach to explain your project and contributions
better_answer_example: Here's an example of a better answer: 'As a cloud engineer, I've had hands-on experience with AWS, Linux, and Terraform. In my current project, I worked on a student management system where I identified and resolved the issue of duplicate student records. I achieved this by discussing the unclear requirements with my team, testing the fix, and implementing it. This experience has prepared me to handle similar challenges in a cloud engineer role.'
